verdict.rationale: Aider has no documented way to sign in with a vendor subscription plan. The closest evidence is its copy/paste mode, which lets you use an LLM through its web chat interface, so an existing chat subscription can be used indirectly. The docs themselves say aider works best with LLM APIs, which makes this a manual workaround rather than a sign-in. Missing for 10: any subscription/account sign-in or OAuth flow, documentation of which subscription plans are supported, and hands-on corroboration of using a subscription plan with aider.
